love.summary: Most readers sense a romantic turning point this week for Aquarius, whether through a new connection or a long-strained relationship finally shifting, so releasing past wounds and allowing things to unfold gradually will serve you best.
love.disagreement: Some readers saw fresh romantic beginnings and new love interests emerging, while others pointed to unresolved past relationships or difficult situations like divorce resurfacing as the central focus.

finance.summary: Most readers sense a significant financial shift or turning point this week, so take your time reviewing any agreements or decisions carefully before committing to ensure the outcome truly serves you.
finance.disagreement: Some readers saw financial struggles easing into stability and reward, while others cautioned that things may not be as promising as they appear on the surface.

career.summary: Most readers sense professional recognition or a meaningful career breakthrough coming for Aquarius, so taking focused, disciplined action rather than staying stuck in hesitation is the clearest path forward this week.
career.disagreement: Some readers highlighted positive recognition and advancement ahead, while one focused on workplace conflict around compensation or hours, suggesting a more confrontational or transitional shift may be needed first.

family.summary: Most readers see family connections as a source of warmth and renewal this week, so lean into those relationships by sharing good news, welcoming visits, or simply retreating into the comfort of home and loved ones.
family.disagreement: One reader pointed to deeper family tensions around inheritance or estate matters, while others focused on joyful, uplifting connection with loved ones.

overall_tone_summary: Two cautionary readings anchor a week that rewards careful, measured steps forward.
